mapper.select: SELECT mv.id, mv.monitor_point_id AS monitorPointId, mv.equipment_id AS equipmentId, mv.monitor_data AS monitorData, mv.monitor_time AS monitorTime, mp.point_name AS monitorPointName, mp.unit AS unit, eq.asset_name AS equipmentName FROM monitor_value mv INNER JOIN equipment_monitor_point mp ON mv.monitor_point_id = mp.id INNER JOIN equipment_assets eq ON mv.equipment_id = eq.asset_id WHERE mv.equipment_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY mv.monitor_time DESC
